senses.gloss:
(इ) चुडि r. 1st cl. (चुण्डति)
To become small, low or shallow.
r. 10th cl. (चुण्डयति)
To cut, to pierce or divide.

r. 1st cl. (चुड्डति)
1 To hint one's meaning.
2 To dally, to wanton, to coquet, &c.
3 To act.

f. (-डा)
1 A single lock of hair left on the crown of the head at the ceremony of tonsure.
2 A peacock's crest.
3 Any crest, plume, diadem, &c.
4 The head.
5 Top, summit.
6 An upper house, a room on the top of a house, &c.
7 A kind of bracelet.
8 A small well.
9 Tonsure; more commonly चूडाकरणं.
E.
चूल to elevate, अङ् and टाप् affixes, ल changed to ड, and the vowel lengthened.

m. (-कः)
A well.
E.
चुड to become shallow, affix क्वुन् and the vowel lengthened.

n. (-णं)
Shaving the head all but one lock, considered as a religious, and purificatory rite; it should be performed in the first or third year.
E.
चूडा, and करण making.

n. (-र्म्म)
The rite of tonsure: see the last.
E.
चूडा, and कर्म्म act.

m. (-णिः)
1 A jewel worn in a crest or a diadem.
2 The Gunja, (Abrus precatorius.)
E.
चूडा a crest, and मणि a jewel.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Crested, having a lock of hair on the crown of the head, &c.
f. (-ला)
A kind of grass, (Kyllinga monocephala.)
n. (-लं)
The head.
E.
चूडा a crest, and ल what has, from ला with ड affix, or लच् poss. aff.

n. (-णं)
Tonsure.
E.
चूडा, and लक्षण mark.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत)
Crested, having a lock of hair, &c. on the top of the head.
E.
चूडा a crest, and मतुप् aff.
